reel.caption:
Did you forget an old bank account or FD?

Banks held ₹98,073 crore of unclaimed deposits in the RBI's depositor fund as of 31 Jan 2026.
An account or FD left untouched for 10 years moves there, but it doesn't stop being yours.
Search across banks on the RBI's unclaimed deposits portal, then claim at that bank. Nominees and legal heirs can claim too.

Does anyone in your family have an account they haven't used in years?

Sources: two business news explainers on unclaimed deposits (Jul and Aug 2026), citing Finance Ministry data in Parliament.

For education only. Not investment advice.
Voiceover is AI-generated.
